Design + Engineering FAQ

Useful answers before you begin.

Does VR Plus provide engineering services directly?

Projects are coordinated with appropriately qualified design and engineering professionals based on the scope and permit requirements.

What is a constructability review?

It is a review of drawings and details from a construction perspective to identify coordination, access, sequencing or material issues before work proceeds.

Can you coordinate an existing design team?

Yes. VR Plus Construction can work with consultants already selected by the client.
